## Circular to Licensed Corporations

## Responsible Officers

It  has  come  to  our  attention  that  certain  corporations  licensed  under  section  116  of  the Securities and Futures Ordinance ('SFO') failed to maintain at least 2 responsible officers for each  regulated  activity  they  are  licensed  for.  Section  125(1)  of  the  SFO  provides  that  a licensed  corporation  under  such  circumstance shall  not  carry  on  the  related  regulated activity . Contravention with this requirement, without reasonable excuse, is an offence under the  law  and  if  convicted,  the  licensed  corporation  concerned  is  liable  to  a  fine  of  up  to $100,000 and to a further fine of $2,000 for every day during which the offence continues. In addition, the licensed corporation and its related responsible officer may also be subjected to disciplinary proceeding.

The Commission therefore urges licensed corporations to review their own situation and to plan ahead to avoid breaching the relevant provisions of the legislation.  Licensed corporations should  immediately  contact  their  Intermediaries  Relationship  Manager  of  the  Licensing Department  if  they  foresee  difficulties  in  the  continuous  compliance  with  those  provisions. Please  also  be  reminded  that  all  responsible  officers'  appointments  become  effective  only upon the Commission's approval.

Please note that this requirement does NOT apply to those licensed corporations which have yet  to  migrate  to  the  new  regime  as  they  are  deemed  to  have  complied  with  the  necessary requirement under the transitional provisions of the SFO.

Should you have any queries, please do not hesitate to contact your Intermediaries Relationship Manager.

Licensing Department Intermediaries and Investment Products Division Securities and Futures Commission
